title: 第11章 拿南瓜换物资
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 黑市里的交易悄然进行。几盏煤油灯发出昏黄的光，勉强照亮了这片不见天日的交易场所。每个人都蒙着脸，行色匆匆，低声交谈，整个市场弥漫着一种压抑而紧张的气氛。“这位同志，这鸡蛋怎么换？”辰楠蹲下身，压低声音问道。男人抬起头，打量了一下眼前这个看似年纪不大的蒙面人，语气冷淡：“只换细粮。白面、大米都行。”辰楠心里盘算着，细粮他没有，可是他有南瓜。“细粮我没有。”辰楠试探着说，“但我有南瓜，要吗？”“南瓜？”摊主看向辰楠，有些失望，“你在逗我玩吗？”南瓜不是主食，虽然也能填饱肚子，但价格是比较廉价的。市面上一般是两三分钱一斤，在黑市不用粮票价格会高点，如今是三年困难时期，南瓜的价格会更高。“我可没闲情大半夜的跑来这里逗你玩。”辰楠很是认真道：“如果我有很多南瓜呢？”他现在什么都不多，就是南瓜特别多。男人闻言，不耐烦地摆摆手：“少年郎别闹，我这鸡蛋只换细粮。”他显然不想在这少年郎身上浪费时间。辰楠不慌不忙，继续说道：“一斤鸡蛋换三斤南瓜，你看可行？”男人愣了一下，似乎被这个提议打动，但很快又摇摇头：“南瓜市价才两三分钱一斤，黑市上能翻个十倍卖到两三毛。我这鸡蛋现在不要票卖一块五一斤。”辰楠听到这个价格沉默了下来，没想到这鸡蛋涨价如此夸张，按照外面的市价，有鸡蛋票的鸡蛋两毛五一斤，每个人都是定量供给。摊贩见少年郎不说话，想了想伸出一根手指，在辰楠面前晃了晃。辰楠不明所以，这家伙想要干嘛？“十斤换一斤，否则免谈。”这个价格明显是在试探，同时也是在刁难，摊主料定这个年轻人拿不出这么多南瓜。谁知辰楠想都没想就答应了：“成交！你有多少鸡蛋？”这会轮到摊主愣了愣，瞪大了眼睛，似乎是不敢相信自已的耳朵。“我这里有十斤鸡蛋，你当真要拿一百斤南瓜来换？”辰楠点点头，把背上的竹篓放在地上。借着竹篓上那黑布的遮挡，他意念一动，空间里的一个南瓜悄然出现在竹篓中。这南瓜是经过灵泉溪水与精神力催生的，长得特别滋养，个头格外硕大。当辰楠费力地将南瓜从竹篓中抱出来时，摊主惊得差点叫出声来。那南瓜足足有寻常南瓜四五倍大，金黄色的外皮在灯光下泛着诱人的光泽。“这、这是南瓜？”摊主结结巴巴地说，“我活了大半辈子，从没见过这么大的南瓜！”辰楠笑了笑：“乡下种的，土好水好，长得就大了些。”他边说边用手估量着，“这个南瓜至少有一百斤，换你十斤鸡蛋，你还赚了呢。”摊主双手抱起南瓜掂量了下，确定超过一百斤，他连忙点头，生怕辰楠反悔。这南瓜是真大，这得吃多久才能吃完？？？他难得大方的连篮子都交给了辰楠，辰楠掂量了下，大差不差的十斤左右，大概有七八十个鸡蛋。辰楠把装鸡蛋的篮子放进竹篓，实则是放进了空间里面。周围几个摊主也注意到了这边的动静，纷纷投来好奇的目光。“小伙子，你这南瓜是哪来的？”旁边一个卖布料的摊主忍不住问道。辰楠淡定地回答：“这是在乡下种的，今年雨水好，收成不错。“这话说得轻巧，但在场的人都心知肚明。在这样的年景里，能种出这么大的南瓜，可不是一句“雨水好“就能解释的。很多人都没见过上百斤重的南瓜。摊主费劲地想把南瓜装进麻袋，随即把麻袋扛在肩膀上。摊主对着辰楠笑着说道：“要是以后还有这样的南瓜，记得再来找我换鸡蛋。”随即他头也不回地离开，还好他力气大，若是换个女的来，肯定扛不起那么重的南瓜。辰楠点点头，目送摊主离开，他背起竹篓准备离开。这时，旁边一个卖布料的摊主叫住了他。“小兄弟，你还有南瓜吗？我可以用布料换。”另一个卖棉花的也凑过来：“我这儿有新棉花，冬天做棉衣正好，换不换？”很快，辰楠就被几个摊主围住了。在这个物资匮乏的年代，食物永远是最硬通的货币，更何况是这么稀罕的巨型南瓜。辰楠想了想，直接原地坐下，又从竹篓里抱出一个略小一些，但仍有七八十斤重的大南瓜。这个南瓜的出现，立刻引起了周围摊贩的注意。“小伙子，你这南瓜换不换？我这里有上好的棉布！”一个卖布料的摊主急忙凑过来，手里拿着一匹深蓝色的棉布。“换我的吧，我这里有白糖，还有水果糖！”另一个卖副食的摊主也围了上来。很快，辰楠就被七八个摊主团团围住。如此新鲜硕大的南瓜简直比黄金还诱人。“我用两斤白糖换你这个南瓜！”“想啥呢？南瓜那么大，两斤白糖怎么够。”“我出五包'大前门'香烟！”“我这有新到的雪花膏，女人最喜欢了，换不换？”摊主们争先恐后地报出自已的价码，但辰楠注意到，几乎没有人提出用粮食来交换。这也难怪，在这困难时间，谁家要是有余粮，肯定都留着自已吃了，哪舍得拿出来换南瓜。“大伙都静静。”辰楠赶紧摆摆手，“我这一个南瓜有八九十斤，你们的东西太少，除非合在一起，否则根本换不了我一个南瓜。”众人听了这话也慢慢安静了下来，这少年郎说的是实话，他们这三瓜两枣东西，除非合起来，否则也换不了那么重的南瓜。“这样吧，只要是等价的都可以换，你们也可以合在一起跟我换。”辰楠看着一众人，“我的南瓜那么大一个你们也是见到的。”这话顿时引起不少人的议论，东西少的人可以合伙来换个南瓜再分，东西多的人直接就可以换整个或者多个南瓜。
content_en: Transactions on the black market proceed quietly.A few kerosene lamps gave off a dim light, barely illuminating the dark trading place.Everyone covered their faces, walked in a hurry, and talked in low voices. The entire market was filled with a depressing and tense atmosphere."Comrade, how can I change these eggs?" Chen Nan squatted down and asked in a low voice.The man raised his head, looked at the seemingly young masked man in front of him, and said in a cold tone: "Only replace it with fine grains. White flour or rice will do." Chen Nan thought in his mind that he didn't have fine grains, but he had pumpkins."I don't have fine grains." Chen Nan said tentatively, "But I have pumpkin, do you want it?" "Pumpkin?" The stall owner looked at Chen Nan, a little disappointed, "Are you kidding me?" Pumpkin is not a staple food. Although it can fill the stomach, the price is relatively cheap.The price on the market is usually two or three cents per pound. If you don’t use food stamps, the price will be higher on the black market. Now is the difficult period of three years, and the price of pumpkins will be even higher."I don't have the leisure to come here to tease you in the middle of the night." Chen Nan said seriously: "What if I have a lot of pumpkins?" He doesn't have many things now, but he has a lot of pumpkins.Hearing this, the man waved his hands impatiently: "Young man, don't make trouble, I only exchange eggs for fine grain." He obviously didn't want to waste time on this young man.Chen Nan calmly continued, "Do you think it's feasible to exchange one pound of eggs for three pounds of pumpkin?" The man was stunned for a moment and seemed to be moved by the proposal, but then quickly shook his head: "The market price of pumpkins is only two or three cents per pound. On the black market, it can be sold for ten times as much as two cents."Thirty cents.I don’t need tickets now to sell my eggs for one dollar and a half a pound." Chen Nan fell silent when he heard the price. He didn’t expect the price of eggs to increase so much. According to the market price outside, eggs with egg stamps are 25 cents a pound, and everyone is rationed.Seeing that the young man was silent, the vendor thought for a moment and stretched out a finger and waved it in front of Chen Nan.Chen Nan didn't know why, what did this guy want to do?"Ten pounds for one pound, otherwise there is no need to discuss." This price was obviously a test, but also a challenge. The stall owner expected that the young man would not be able to bring out so many pumpkins.Unexpectedly, Chen Nan agreed without thinking: "Deal! How many eggs do you have?" It was the stall owner's turn to be stunned, his eyes widened, as if he couldn't believe his ears."I have ten kilograms of eggs here, do you really want to exchange them for a hundred kilograms of pumpkins?" Chen Nan nodded and put the bamboo basket on his back on the ground.Blocked by the black cloth on the bamboo basket, he thought, and a pumpkin in the space quietly appeared in the bamboo basket.This pumpkin was born through the water of the spiritual spring stream and spiritual power. It grew particularly nourished and was extremely large.When Chen Nan struggled to take the pumpkin out of the bamboo basket, the stall owner almost screamed in shock.The pumpkin was four or five times the size of an ordinary pumpkin, and its golden skin shone attractively under the light."This, this is a pumpkin?" the stall owner stammered, "I have lived for most of my life, and I have never seen such a big pumpkin!" Chen Nan smiled: "It is grown in the countryside, with good soil and water, so it grows bigger." He said while measuring it with his hands, "This pumpkin weighs at least one hundred kilograms. If you exchange it for ten kilograms of eggs, you will still make a profit." The stall owner picked up the pumpkin with both hands and weighed it, confirming that it was more than one hundred kilograms. He nodded quickly, fearing that Chen Nan would regret it.This pumpkin is really big. How long will it take to finish it???He was so generous that he even handed the basket to Chen Nan. Chen Nan weighed it and found that it weighed about ten kilograms and contained about seventy or eighty eggs.Chen Nan put the basket of eggs into the bamboo basket, which actually put it into the space.Several stall owners around also noticed the movement here and cast curious glances."Young man, where did you get this pumpkin?" A stall owner selling fabrics nearby couldn't help but ask.Chen Nan replied calmly: "This is planted in the countryside. The rain this year is good and the harvest is good." This was said lightly, but everyone present knew it.In such a year, the ability to grow such a large pumpkin cannot be explained by just "good rain".Many people have never seen a pumpkin weighing hundreds of pounds.The stall owner struggled to put the pumpkin into the sack, and then put the sack on his shoulder.The stall owner smiled at Chen Nan and said: "If there are pumpkins like this in the future, remember to come to me again to exchange eggs." Then he left without looking back. Fortunately, he was strong. If it were a woman, she would definitely not be able to carry such a heavy pumpkin.Chen Nan nodded and watched the stall owner leave. He picked up the bamboo basket and prepared to leave.At this time, a stall owner selling fabrics nearby stopped him."Little brother, do you still have pumpkins? I can exchange them with fabric." Another cotton seller came over and said, "I have new cotton here, which is good for making cotton-padded clothes in winter. Do you want to exchange it?" Soon, Chen Nan was surrounded by several stall owners.In this era of scarcity, food is always the hardest currency, not to mention such a rare giant pumpkin.Chen Nan thought for a while, then sat down on the spot, and took out a slightly smaller pumpkin from the bamboo basket, but still weighing seventy or eighty kilograms.The appearance of this pumpkin immediately attracted the attention of the surrounding vendors."Young man, do you want to change your pumpkin? I have good cotton here!" A stall owner selling fabrics hurriedly came over, holding a piece of dark blue cotton in his hand."Take mine instead. I have sugar and fruit candies here!" Another stall owner selling non-staple food also gathered around.Soon, Chen Nan was surrounded by seven or eight stall owners.Such fresh and huge pumpkins are more attractive than gold."I'll give you two kilograms of sugar in exchange for your pumpkin!" "What are you thinking? The pumpkin is so big, two kilograms of sugar is not enough." "I'll give you five packs of 'Da Qianmen' cigarettes!" "I have a newly arrived cream, women like it the most, do you want to exchange it?" The stall owners rushed to quote their prices, but Chen Nan noticed that almost no one offered to exchange food.It's no wonder that during this difficult time, if any family had surplus food, they would definitely keep it for themselves and eat it instead of exchanging it for pumpkins."Everyone, please be quiet." Chen Nan quickly waved his hand, "My pumpkin weighs eighty or ninety pounds. You have too little. Unless you put them all together, you can't exchange them for one of my pumpkins." After hearing this, everyone slowly became quiet. The young man was telling the truth. Unless they were put together, they couldn't exchange for such a heavy pumpkin."Well, as long as they are of equal value, they can be exchanged. You can also come together to exchange with me." Chen Nan looked at the group of people, "You have seen my pumpkin as big as mine." This immediately aroused a lot of discussion. People with few things can work together to exchange pumpkins and then divide them. People with more things can directly exchange the whole or multiple pumpkins.
